context: Measure first (wheel size, import benchbox time, CI touchpoints). Update future-state/index.md and the two proposal READMEs so they share one status. Do not extract in this item.
description:
docs/design/future-state/index.md ranks 'Remove release tooling from wheel' and 'Isolate experimental subsystems' as High / Tier 1 Act now, citing 'evidence of need'. The proposal READMEs contain no wheel-size, import-time, CI-burden, or demand numbers. isolate-experimental-core-subsystems and remove-release-tooling-from-wheel are already done as namespace/config moves — the remaining question is further extraction (companion package, extra, MANIFEST prune).

This item must not leave two authorities. After measurements, either:
1) confirm the High ranking and open a follow-up implementation item with numbers in the proposal, or
2) supersede the index (lower the ranking or mark blocked-on-evidence) in the same PR as the measurement note.

An optional extra does not remove code from the wheel. psutil>=5.9.0 is already a core dependency; runner already degrades if monitoring import fails. Do not extra-gate monitoring without a measured install-size win.

Companion packages add versioning, CI, release, and dependency-skew cost. Require install-size, import-time, CI minutes, demand, and release-cost evidence before any extraction.

Depends on arch-tier-commitment-decision so extraction is not sized against an uncommitted inventory.

Out of scope: implementing the extraction; MCP production publication.

anti_patterns.dont: gate monitoring behind an extra without measuring install size
anti_patterns.why: psutil is already core and the runner degrades today

anti_patterns.dont: implement extraction because the index says High
leave the index at High while this item says undecided
treat an extra as wheel exclusion
anti_patterns.instead: measure both extra and exclude if extraction is confirmed
anti_patterns.why: code still ships unless MANIFEST/excludes change

preserves.behavior: Default-wheel contents do not change in this item
Every future-state proposal has exactly one status after this item
No companion package is created in this item
psutil remains a core dependency unless a measured follow-up says otherwise
